How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    The Amazon Basics Classic Notebook is a simple and affordable notebook that is perfect for everyday use. It has 240 pages of lined paper, a cardboard cover, and an elastic closure. The paper is made from acid-free material, so it will not yellow or deteriorate over time. The notebook is available in a variety of colors, so you can choose one that suits your style.

    I have been using the Amazon Basics Classic Notebook for a few months now, and I am very happy with it. It is a great notebook for taking notes, jotting down ideas, or sketching. The paper is smooth and easy to write on, and the notebook is sturdy enough to withstand everyday use. I would definitely recommend the Amazon Basics Classic Notebook to anyone looking for a simple and affordable notebook.

    Here are some of the pros and cons of the Amazon Basics Classic Notebook:

    Pros:

    Affordable

    Simple design

    Acid-free paper

    Sturdy construction

    Available in a variety of colors

    Cons:

    The paper is not as thick as some other notebooks

    The cover is not as durable as some other notebooks

    Overall, the Amazon Basics Classic Notebook is a great option for anyone looking for a simple and affordable notebook. It is well-made and will last for a long time.

    Here are some tips for using the Amazon Basics Classic Notebook:

    Use the notebook for taking notes, jotting down ideas, or sketching.

    The paper is smooth and easy to write on, so you can use any type of pen or pencil.

    The notebook is sturdy enough to withstand everyday use, so you can take it with you wherever you go.

    The notebook is available in a variety of colors, so you can choose one that suits your style.

  • Nyx K
    5 out of 5 stars
    Its perfect for what I need it for
    Reviewed in the United States on April 1, 2021
    Style: RuledSize: 1 Pack
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I had a little black book about 5x thicker than this and maybe another half larger than this one, which was hard back but had a nice soft leather like finish. Sadly it was 6 years old and my cat decided it no longer belonged on the table. I found the binding completely busted, separating at the seems and it was no longer of any use to me now. That also included pages that tore loose during the fall messing up information I had. Very very important information that I prefer to note down because I cant always remember everything all the time with a hectic and busy schedule.

    So i decided to search for a replacement and the Amazon Basics Classic Lined Notebook, 240 Pages, Hardcover was the one I finally decided on. It feels sturdy and the quality is nice but I didnt rate if it holds up or is super sturdy. Im not looking to test it out but my guess with it still being new, it can take quiet a few tumbles off of the table top by the cat for a few years without me worrying about it.

    --Update--

    My cat and new puppy decided they would test out how durable this thing was. I know my cat likes to knock things off the table some times, and well our new 1yr mastiff puppy thought he would join in. I woke up to all fours ends of my notebook chewed on, but luckily none of my information in the book got ruined. The stretch band was still on it and not even damaged. Im still able to see all of whats in it, though the pages are damaged to the point I have to carefully pull them apart cause they sort of stick together. I bought two more of these cause im going to transfer the information from the damaged on to a new one and of course store it somewhere safe. I wanted a 3rd for backup or maybe for something else entirely. Maybe for recipes. I really love the quality of these books and even after the dog tried his best to shred through it, it held up enough to keep what was inside of it still legible

    This notebook is my EVERYTHING. It's very durable and will last you a lifetime! I bought it last year for school to take notes (I still haven't finished using it yet) and I'm OBSESSED! The paper is lined and has a yellow-ish tint (which I love honestly) and is of great quality. This notebook has a hard front and back cover so that the paper doesn't crease if you accidentally bend it. Inside, there's a strip of fabric that acts as a bookmark when you need it. The notebook has an elastic band so that nothing opens when you drop it, and It's not very big which makes it a great choice if you're travelling! Overall, 10/10 recommend for all ages and uses.
